# Welcome {#welcome .unnumbered}

::: {.tada-hero}
::: {.tada-hero-text}
<p class="tada-eyebrow">Best practice for code sharing</p>

## Code that runs for someone else, not just for you {.unlisted .unnumbered}

Much of the code behind published papers is never shared, and what is shared
often won't run. This wiki sets out four steps to take before you submit a
paper: make your code **T**ransferable, **A**vailable, **D**ocumented and
**A**nnotated.
:::

::: {.tada-hero-figure}
![](assets/figures/wizard-tada.png){alt="A cartoon wizard casting a spell, saying TADA!"}
:::
:::

## The four principles {.unnumbered}

::: {.tada-cards .tada-cards--links}
::: {.tada-card .t}
[T]{.tada-letter} [Transferable](#transferable){.tada-word}
[Runs on someone else's machine.]{.tada-gloss}
:::

::: {.tada-card .a1}
[A]{.tada-letter} [Available](#available){.tada-word}
[Archived, with a DOI.]{.tada-gloss}
:::

::: {.tada-card .d}
[D]{.tada-letter} [Documented](#documented){.tada-word}
[A README and a licence.]{.tada-gloss}
:::

::: {.tada-card .a2}
[A]{.tada-letter} [Annotated](#annotated){.tada-word}
[Comments that explain the code.]{.tada-gloss}
:::
:::
